scenario: Submit a complete application with a PDF resume
steps: Fill every required field, attach test-qa-resume.pdf, tick consent, Submit Application
expected: "Application received" with a reference ID; application stored with status new
actual: Application received with reference ID; stored with status new and resume

scenario: Submit the empty form
steps: Click Submit Application
expected: Required-field errors, nothing stored
actual: Required fields flagged, nothing stored

scenario: Resume with a disallowed file type is rejected
steps: Attach test-qa-notes.txt, submit
expected: "Resume must be PDF, DOC, or DOCX." and nothing stored
actual: Message shown, no application stored

scenario: Typed values survive a server-side rejection
steps: Submit, read the fields after the error appears
expected: All typed values and the attached file are still in the form
actual: Initially every field was wiped (DEF-004). After the fix the values and file are kept

scenario: Inactive job does not accept applications
preconditions: [TEST] QA Job closed published with active = false
steps: Open the job page; then post the apply action with this job's ID
expected: Page shows "no longer accepting applications"; action rejects, nothing stored; job hidden from /careers
actual: Form hidden with the closed message; action rejected; nothing stored; not listed

scenario: Job past its application deadline does not accept applications
preconditions: [TEST] QA Job expired published, active, deadline 2026-01-15
steps: Open /careers and the job page; then post the apply action with this job's ID
expected: Not listed, page shows closed message, action rejects
actual: Initially listed and accepting applications (DEF-005). After the fix: not listed, closed message, action rejected

scenario: Too-short message is rejected and typed values are kept
steps: Fill name, email, company, job title, country, phone; message "short"; Submit
expected: "Please provide a brief message", fields keep their values, nothing stored
actual: Field error shown, values kept, nothing stored

scenario: Valid enquiry creates a lead and clears the form
steps: Fill all fields with a TEST-QA message, Submit
expected: Thank-you message, form cleared, lead stored with status new, notify email sent
actual: Thank-you message, form cleared, lead stored (intent business, status new), SMTP send completed

scenario: Bot submission with the hidden honeypot field filled is discarded
steps: Fill the form and the hidden website field, Submit
expected: Bot sees a success message; nothing is stored or emailed
actual: Request returned in 24 ms with success; no lead stored

scenario: Invalid email is rejected and kept in the field
steps: Enter not-an-email, Subscribe
expected: "Please enter a valid email address.", value kept
actual: Message shown, value kept

scenario: Signing up twice with the same email creates one subscriber
steps: Subscribe with the same email twice
expected: Both show "Thanks for subscribing." (no enumeration); exactly one active subscriber
actual: Same message both times, field cleared, one active subscriber (see NEWS case in pipelines)

scenario: Every workspace is reachable from the sidebar and command palette
steps: Expand each module group; open the command palette and scroll the list
expected: SEO Center, Newsletter Hub, CRM Pipeline, Hiring Pipeline, Media Studio, Insights Dashboard, Activity Timeline and AI Workspace all listed; active item highlighted with correct breadcrumb
actual: Initially only AI Workspace was linked; the other 7 were only reachable by typing the URL (DEF-007). After the fix all 8 are listed, highlighted, and breadcrumbed (e.g. Media > Media Studio)

area: Header + sidebar Create menus, command palette
scenario: Quick Create only offers collections the user may create
steps: Open both Create menus and the command palette
expected: No "Notification" entry (notifications cannot be created); every entry opens a working create form
actual: Initially "Notification" opened an Unauthorized page (DEF-008). After the fix the menus are filtered by the user's create permission; 18 entries, all render

scenario: Header Create menu closes on Escape and outside click
steps: Press Escape; reopen and click elsewhere on the page
expected: Menu closes both times
actual: Initially it stayed open (and overlapped the command palette) (DEF-009). After the fix it closes on both

scenario: Live search finds TEST records with readable group names
steps: Open the palette, type "QA Lead"
expected: [TEST] QA Lead listed under "Contact Messages"; Escape closes the palette
actual: Found after the 220 ms debounce; group label was the raw slug "Contact-Messages" before the search fix (DEF-010), now "Contact Messages"; Escape closes

scenario: Bell panel lists recent notifications for TEST activity
preconditions: TEST application, lead, interview and publishes created
steps: Click the bell
expected: Panel lists New job application, New lead, Interview scheduled, Content published entries
actual: All listed with TEST titles; unread badge shown

scenario: Theme toggle switches and persists across navigation
steps: Click the toggle, open another admin page
expected: data-theme=dark, stored in xe-theme-preference, still dark after navigation
actual: As expected

scenario: Dashboard metrics and lists reflect TEST activity
steps: Open the dashboard and wait for the count-up animation
expected: Leads and Applications counts include TEST records; recent activity lists TEST events
actual: Leads 3 (2 need reply), Applications 3 (1 new); TEST events in Recent Activity and Recruitment list

scenario: SEO Center shows the per-collection audit and recent insights
steps: Open SEO Center
expected: Audit rows per collection, sitemap/robots links, recent insights including [TEST] QA Blog
actual: Rendered with all rows and [TEST] QA Blog listed

scenario: Generate a blog outline and write it back as a draft
preconditions: Logged in as super-admin; no AI key configured (templates used)
steps: Mode Blog outline, topic "[TEST] QA AI Blog", tick Create Payload draft, Generate
expected: Outline shown, draft blog test-qa-ai-blog created, Open draft link
actual: Outline shown; draft blog test-qa-ai-blog created (status draft); link opens it

scenario: Media Studio lists assets and recent uploads
steps: Open Media Studio
expected: Asset count and recent assets including test-qa uploads
actual: Assets 7, test-qa-resume.pdf, test-qa-brochure.pdf, test-qa-hero.webp listed

scenario: Admin PWA manifest, icons, offline page and service worker
steps: Fetch manifest, all icons, sw.js and offline.html; check service worker registration in the browser
expected: All 200 with correct content types; admin service worker active with scope /admin
actual: All 200; 9 icons OK; admin worker activated and controlling the page

scenario: List page at 390 px (phone) and 1440 px (desktop)
steps: Emulate 390x844, then desktop
expected: No horizontal page overflow; filters stack; rows become cards; header actions reachable
actual: Document width equals viewport at 390 px; filters stacked; card rows; header actions visible
